entities.name: Qarsi Palace
entities.description: A sprawling, opulent complex among the waterways of the Gudul delta on Tarkir, once a temple compound and the heart of the Sultai government.

entities.name: Gudul delta
entities.description: The delta of Tarkir where Qarsi Palace lies.

entities.name: Kheru City
entities.description: Primary urban hub of the Sultai within the delta, with Qarsi Palace at its center.

entities.name: Kheru temple complex
entities.description: The temple complex absorbed into the palace's architecture.

entities.name: Sultai brood
entities.description: The brood ruled from Qarsi Palace under Silumgar.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: Ruler of the Sultai brood under whom the palace became the seat of power.

entities.name: Sidisi
entities.description: A cunning naga vizier who ruled much of the day-to-day from the palace; later escapes into exile.

entities.name: Gurmag
entities.description: Swamps where Sidisi plots in exile.

entities.name: Rakshasa
entities.description: Powerful allies of Sidisi in exile; agents gather in Kheru City.

events.summary: Under Silumgar, Qarsi Palace becomes the seat of power for the whole Sultai brood, with Sidisi running much of its daily rule.
events.quote: Under Silumgar, Qarsi Palace became the seat of power for the entire Sultai brood.

events.summary: As the New Phyrexian Invasion reaches Tarkir, rebellions in the brood culminate in a raid on Qarsi Palace.
events.quote: rising rebellions within the brood culminated in a daring raid on Qarsi Palace itself

events.summary: Gravely injured in the raid, Sidisi escapes into the swamps of Gurmag and plots with rakshasa allies to reclaim her throne.
events.quote: Gravely injured in the attack, Sidisi escaped into the swamps of Gurmag

relations.quote: Qarsi Palace is located at the center of Kheru City

relations.note: Vizier ruling day-to-day under his rule
relations.quote: The cunning naga vizier Sidisi ruled much of the day-to-day from within its halls

relations.note: Plots in exile with rakshasa allies
relations.quote: she now plots in exile with powerful rakshasa allies
